payload.name: PlateLens
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring PlateLens—an AI-powered calorie and nutrition tracker—into ChatGPT. Ask about the data you already log: review calories, macros, micronutrients, and ingredients; understand your estimated calorie deficit or surplus against your plan; summarize hydration and activity; follow weight changes against your goals; and review recorded glucose readings with their measurement times and provenance when you grant the separate glucose permission. The integration is read-only and cannot create, edit, or delete PlateLens data. Results reflect estimates and synced observations in your account, not diagnoses, treatment advice, or medication recommendations.
payload.longDescription: 将 AI 卡路里与营养追踪器 PlateLens 引入 ChatGPT。询问您已记录的数据：查看卡路里、宏量营养素、微量营养素和食材；根据计划了解估算的热量缺口或盈余；汇总饮水和活动情况；根据目标追踪体重变化；在您授予单独的血糖权限后，还可查看记录的血糖读数及其测量时间和来源。此集成为只读，无法创建、编辑或删除 PlateLens 数据。结果反映您账户中的估算值和同步观测数据，不构成诊断、治疗建议或用药建议。

payload.name: 84asana
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
84asana is a free classical yoga guide for beginners.

• 13 foundational asanas with step-by-step instructions, benefits, and contraindications
• Complete warm-up sequence — Arrival & Centering, 15 Joint Rotations, and Surya Namaskar
• 40-minute Dhyana meditation practice with breath awareness and Brumadhyam focus
• No login, no account, no payment — completely free

Ask anything: "List me all asanas", "Show me Tree Pose", "Take me through the warm-up", or "Guide me through meditation".
payload.longDescription:
84asana 是一款专为初学者设计的免费古典瑜伽指南。

• 13 个基础体式，包含逐步指导、益处及禁忌
• 完整的热身序列——到达与专注、15 个关节旋转和太阳礼
• 40 分钟的禅定冥想练习，结合呼吸觉知与布鲁玛迪亚姆专注
• 无需登录、注册账户或支付——完全免费

随时提问：「列出所有体式」、「展示树式」、「带我做热身」或「指导我进行冥想」。

payload.name: Health Memory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Health memory helps you save and manage personal health notes directly through ChatGPT. You can create topics, organize information, and keep track of things like symptoms, medications, and questions for your doctor—all in one place.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to save, and it will securely store it in your health memory account on Triangle Health. You can also ask to retrieve or update your notes whenever you need them.

Health memory is designed with privacy and control in mind. You decide what information is shared, and all actions are performed only with your explicit permission.

This app is intended solely for personal note-taking and organization. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment recommendations.
payload.longDescription:
Health Memory 帮助你直接通过 ChatGPT 保存和管理个人健康笔记。你可以创建主题、整理信息，并在一处记录症状、药物以及要咨询医生的问题等内容。

只需告诉 ChatGPT 想保存什么，信息便会安全地存入你在 Triangle Health 的健康记忆账号。需要时也可要求检索或更新笔记。

Health Memory 注重隐私和控制权。你可以决定分享哪些信息，所有操作都只会在获得你明确许可后执行。

此应用仅用于个人记录和整理，不提供医疗建议、诊断或治疗建议。

payload.name: Joti
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Joti is a workout tracking app for planning, scheduling, and logging strength, bodyweight, flexibility, and cardio training. This connector lets ChatGPT read a user's own workouts, completed workout history, aggregated stats (volume, consistency, personal bests, top lifts), and the shared exercise library (roughly 800 exercises plus the user's own custom ones), and to schedule workouts onto the user's calendar. Writes are additive only: create a brand-new workout, duplicate an existing one, and fully manage scheduled-workout calendar entries. It cannot edit or delete an existing workout's exercises/sets, and cannot start, log, or alter a session — those stay in the Joti app. Body measurements and progress photos are out of scope entirely. Reads are scoped to data the user owns outright; every write is undoable in Joti's Activity feed.
payload.longDescription: Joti 是一款训练记录应用，用于规划、安排和记录力量、自重、柔韧性及有氧训练。此连接器让 ChatGPT 读取用户自己的训练计划、已完成训练的历史记录、汇总统计（训练量、坚持情况、个人最佳成绩、表现最佳的力量动作）及共享动作库（约 800 个动作，加上用户自定义的动作），并将训练安排到用户日历中。训练计划写入仅支持新增：创建全新的训练计划或复制已有计划；同时可全面管理日历中的已安排训练条目。它不能编辑或删除已有训练计划的动作或组数，也不能开始、记录或修改一次实际训练，这些操作仍需在 Joti 应用中完成。身体测量数据和进度照片完全不在访问范围内。读取仅限于用户本人拥有的数据；每次写入都可在 Joti 的 Activity 动态记录中撤销。

payload.name: Atlante Clinico
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Atlante’s published psychotherapy repertoire by topic, title, author or orientation. Choose a technique to open its procedure, cautions and sources. Connect your existing verified Atlante account; its access allowances apply. Connection screens support English and Italian. Publications retain their source language; translations generated by your assistant are identified separately. Use general topic queries without patient identifiers.
payload.longDescription: 按主题、标题、作者或流派搜索 Atlante 已发布的心理治疗方法库。选择一种技术，打开其操作流程、注意事项和来源。连接现有且已验证的 Atlante 账户，其访问额度仍适用。连接界面支持英语和意大利语。出版内容保留原始语言；助手生成的译文会单独标识。请使用一般性主题查询，不包含患者身份标识。

payload.name: Reframe: Drink Less Alcohol
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reframe is the #1 alcohol reduction app, built to help you drink less and live more. Whether your goal is to cut back or quit drinking entirely, Reframe's neuroscience approach can help you change the way alcohol shows up in your life.

With a core 160-day, evidence-based, education program, progress tracking, world's largest private community of people cutting back, and a multitude of tools (think meditations, games, and more!), you've got everything you need to change your relationship with booze at the click of a button
payload.longDescription:
Reframe 是 #1 减少饮酒应用，旨在帮助你少喝酒、享受更多生活。无论你的目标是减少饮酒还是完全戒酒，Reframe 的神经科学方法都能帮助你改变酒精在生活中的影响。

该应用包含核心的 160 天循证教育计划、进度跟踪、全球最大的戒酒或减酒者私人社群，以及多种工具（例如冥想、游戏等）。只需轻点按钮，你就拥有改变自己与酒精关系所需的一切。

payload.name: Volm
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan your training with ChatGPT and take it to the gym with Volm. Keep your workouts, programs, and training history in one place, giving ChatGPT the context to help you build a plan around your goals and schedule. Follow your workouts set by set in the Volm app, then review your progress with ChatGPT and adjust what comes next. Connect your Volm account for free.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT 规划训练，并将计划带到健身房。使用 Volm 将训练内容、训练计划和训练记录集中管理，让 ChatGPT 根据你的目标和日程提供规划建议。在 Volm 应用中逐组跟练，然后通过 ChatGPT 查看进展并调整后续安排。免费连接 Volm 账户。

payload.name: PAWFECT | PUPPY YOGA
payload.description: 预订附近的幼犬瑜伽活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stretch, create, and cuddle! Pawfect Max combines relaxing yoga and guided painting with the playful joy of puppies. Wellness meets wagging tails in this fun, feel-good workshop.
payload.longDescription: 伸展、创作、拥抱！Pawfect Max 将放松瑜伽和引导绘画与幼犬的活泼乐趣结合起来。在这场有趣又令人愉悦的工作坊中，健康体验遇上摇摆的尾巴。

payload.name: TRAINEDBY
payload.description: 依据已验证记录辅导客户
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TRAINEDBY lets an authenticated coach use ChatGPT with the clients currently on that coach’s roster. It can read workouts, meals, check-ins, body progress and supported health evidence; investigate patterns; and prepare precise workout or nutrition drafts. External AI cannot publish plan-affecting changes: the coach reviews and applies them inside TRAINEDBY.
payload.longDescription: TRAINEDBY 允许已通过身份验证的教练在 ChatGPT 中使用目前列于该教练名下的客户数据。它可以读取训练、饮食、签到、身体进度和受支持的健康证据；调查规律；并准备精确的训练或营养计划草稿。外部 AI 无法发布会影响计划的更改：教练需在 TRAINEDBY 中审核并应用这些更改。

payload.name: 今天训练
payload.description: 健身训练记录与身体趋势分析
payload.summaryOriginal: 健身训练记录与身体趋势分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: “今天训练”是面向个人健身的训练记录分析插件。连接后，ChatGPT 可查询你在今天训练 App 中已保存并同步的训练记录、每组数据、动作历史和当前计划，帮助复盘训练及比较动作进步。经你单独授权，还可结合身体记录、Apple 健康中的健身与恢复汇总、补剂记录、进度照片、训练路线和已保存的 AI 建议进行分析。插件只读取已授权的档案，不修改或删除记录，不读取未保存的训练草稿。它用于日常健身参考，不提供医疗诊断或治疗。
payload.longDescription: “今天训练”是面向个人健身的训练记录分析插件。连接后，ChatGPT 可查询你在今天训练 App 中已保存并同步的训练记录、每组数据、动作历史和当前计划，帮助复盘训练及比较动作进步。经你单独授权，还可结合身体记录、Apple 健康中的健身与恢复汇总、补剂记录、进度照片、训练路线和已保存的 AI 建议进行分析。插件只读取已授权的档案，不修改或删除记录，不读取未保存的训练草稿。它用于日常健身参考，不提供医疗诊断或治疗。

payload.name: STREEQ
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中查看个人健身记录
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: STREEQ gives an individual controlled access to their own fitness record from ChatGPT. It can read workout, food, body-progress and supported health history; log evidence; and manage the person’s workout programme or nutrition strategy when they own that plan. If an active TRAINEDBY coach owns a plan, STREEQ blocks self-directed plan changes.
payload.longDescription: STREEQ 让个人能够通过 ChatGPT 受控地访问自己的健身记录。它可以读取锻炼、饮食、身体进展和支持的健康历史；记录相关证据；并在用户拥有相应计划时管理其锻炼计划或营养策略。如果某项计划由正在合作的 TRAINEDBY 教练所有，STREEQ 会阻止用户自行更改计划。

payload.name: Calories Club
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calories Club helps users log meals, inspect daily nutrition, search food history, scan barcodes, and record body or water measurements through ChatGPT. The tools create and update private food entries in the user's account, return daily calorie and macro summaries, and show reviewable widgets for meal logging and progress.
payload.longDescription: Calories Club 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 记录餐食、查看每日营养、搜索食物历史、扫描条形码，以及记录身体或饮水测量数据。这些工具会在用户账户中创建和更新私密食物条目，返回每日卡路里和宏量营养素摘要，并显示便于检查的餐食记录和进度小组件。

payload.name: UltraFit360
payload.description: 你的 AI 健身教练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UltraFit360 connects ChatGPT to your personal fitness and nutrition data. Ask what you ate this week, how your weight is trending, what workouts you logged, or for a full progress report — answers come straight from your UltraFit360 food diary, workout logs, body metrics, and AI coaching memory. With your confirmation, it can also log the meals you eat, adjust your daily calorie, macro, water and step targets, plan meals, swap exercises, and assign or build workout programs. Your identity comes solely from your authenticated session, so the app only ever accesses your own data. UltraFit360 is operated by Aptix Labs Private Limited; see https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy for how connector data is handled.
payload.longDescription: UltraFit360 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的个人健身和营养数据。你可以询问本周吃了什么、体重趋势如何、记录了哪些训练，或索取完整进展报告；回答直接来自 UltraFit360 饮食日记、训练记录、身体指标和 AI 教练记忆。经你确认后，它还可以记录你吃过的餐食、调整每日卡路里、宏量营养素、饮水量和步数目标、规划餐食、更换训练动作，以及分配或创建训练计划。你的身份完全依据已验证的登录会话，因此应用只会访问你自己的数据。UltraFit360 由 Aptix Labs Private Limited 运营；有关连接器数据的处理方式，请参阅 https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy。

payload.name: Pregnancy Wheel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn your last menstrual period date or due date into an interactive pregnancy wheel. Instantly see your current week, trimester, due date, and days remaining, along with a fun fruit-size comparison for how big your baby is right now. You can also look up any week from 1 to 42 to see what's ahead, even without a specific date.

This app is developed by an independent developer and is not a medical device or a substitute for professional medical, obstetric, or midwifery advice. Always consult your doctor, midwife, or other qualified healthcare provider regarding your pregnancy and prenatal care.
payload.longDescription:
输入末次月经日期或预产期，即可生成互动式孕期轮盘。立即查看当前孕周、孕期阶段、预产期和剩余天数，并通过有趣的水果大小对比了解宝宝现在有多大。你也可以查询第 1 周到第 42 周的任意一周，了解接下来会发生什么，即使没有具体日期也可以。

此应用由独立开发者开发，不是医疗器械，也不能替代专业医疗、产科或助产建议。有关孕期和产前护理，请务必咨询医生、助产士或其他合格的医疗服务提供者。

payload.name: Health
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中探索健康数据
payload.summaryOriginal: Explore your health data in ChatGPT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect supported medical records and Apple Health data to ground ChatGPT conversations in your health information, understand results in context, and follow changes in labs, sleep, and activity over time.
payload.longDescription: 连接受支持的医疗记录及 Apple Health 数据，让 ChatGPT 对话以你的健康信息为依据，结合背景理解结果，并长期跟踪化验、睡眠及活动的变化。

payload.name: rit.run
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: rit.run Coach helps authenticated rit.run users review safe profile, workout, weekly training, heart-rate, and running shoe summaries from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: rit.run Coach 帮助已通过身份验证的 rit.run 用户在 ChatGPT 中查看安全的个人资料、锻炼、每周训练、心率和跑鞋摘要。

payload.name: Stedi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Run real-time patient health insurance eligibility checks across 1,250+ payers using natural language. Get a patient’s coverage details, deductibles, copays, and benefits in seconds. Built-in guidance helps you troubleshoot failed checks, interpret eligibility errors, and resolve common issues quickly.
payload.longDescription: 使用自然语言，对 1,250+ 家付款方进行实时患者健康保险资格核验。几秒钟内即可获取患者的承保详情、免赔额、共付额和福利。内置指南可帮助你排查核验失败、解读资格错误并快速解决常见问题。

payload.name: rit.run
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: rit.run helps connected users review their running activity, heart-rate and pace summaries, running shoes, and active weekly training plan for fitness coaching. Users can compare rit.run runner, shoe, and anonymous route rankings, open privacy-trimmed Google Maps links, request changes to eligible future plan days, and submit training-method or product feedback to rit.run.
payload.longDescription: rit.run 帮助已连接的用户查看跑步活动、心率和配速摘要、跑鞋以及当前每周训练计划，以获得健身指导。用户可以比较 rit.run 跑者、跑鞋和匿名路线排行榜，打开经过隐私处理的 Google Maps 链接，请求调整符合条件的未来计划日，并向 rit.run 提交训练方法或产品反馈。

payload.name: WODone
payload.description: 通过照片记录每日训练
payload.summaryOriginal: Log your WODs from a photo.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WODone turns the gym whiteboard into a training log you can talk to.

Upload a photo of the day's WOD and ChatGPT reads it, then WODone saves it as a structured record: workout type, movements with reps and loads, your score, and the original text exactly as written. Weights and distances are converted to consistent units, and movement names are normalized, so "T2B", "toes to bar", and "Toes-To-Bar" all land on the same movement in your history.

Ask for your records and WODone shows them newest first, or filters by date or movement — "show my thruster workouts from last week". Open one and you also see how you performed each of its movements before, so you can tell whether today was heavier or faster than last time.

Got something wrong? Tell WODone what to fix and it corrects the record, or delete it.

WODone never receives your photos — ChatGPT reads them and passes along only the text.
payload.longDescription:
WODone将健身房的白板变成可互动的训练记录本

上传当天训练内容的照片，ChatGPT会读取内容，WODone将其保存为结构化记录：训练类型、包含次数和重量的动作信息、你的成绩，以及原始文本的完整呈现。重量和距离会统一转换为标准单位，动作名称会进行标准化处理，因此「T2B」「toes to bar」「Toes-To-Bar」等不同写法都会在历史记录中归为同一动作

查询训练记录时，WODone会按最新优先显示，或根据日期/动作筛选——例如「展示我上周的推举训练」。打开具体记录后，还能查看该训练各动作的过往表现数据，便于对比本次训练是否更重或更快

记录有误吗？告诉WODone需要修改的内容，它会自动修正记录或直接删除

WODone不会保存你的照片——ChatGPT读取后仅传递文本内容

payload.name: Match with Care
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UK later-life care: types of care, typical costs, council and NHS funding, arranging care, help for unpaid carers, and ways to pay, from trusted sources. Not medical or medication advice. Does not pick a named carer, browse vacancies, or recommend financial products.
payload.longDescription: 英国老年护理：护理类型、典型费用、地方政府和NHS资金、护理安排方式、对非正式照顾者的帮助以及支付方式，信息来源于可信渠道。不提供医疗或药物建议。不指定特定护理人员、浏览职位空缺或推荐金融产品。

payload.name: Foodzilla
payload.description: 规划膳食，管理您的实践
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Foodzilla is the nutrition platform dietitians, nutritionists and health coaches use to plan, track and run their practice. This plugin puts that work in the conversation.

Ask ChatGPT for a recipe and it is written, costed for macros and saved to your library. Ask for a week of meals to a calorie and macro target and you get a template ready to review and assign. Add a food to your own database from a label or a link. Draft an intake form, set your booking hours, publish a post to your clients, or check where your subscription stands.

Your clients can connect too, if you let them. A client asks their own assistant to log a meal, water, a workout, their sleep or their weight, and to read the plan for the day. Everything they log lands in their diary, where their coach already looks.

Your client data is not reachable from your connection. A coach connection cannot see a client list, a client's diary, their notes or their record, and it cannot message anyone. It works on the coach's own material only: recipes, foods, meal plan templates, collections, forms, booking hours, content, the store and the subscription. A client connection reaches that one client's own record and nobody else's, and cannot change the plan or the targets their coach set for them. Names and email addresses never go into our server logs.

You need a Foodzilla account. Foodzilla Autopilot is included with the Professional plan and above. Client access is a switch the coach controls, for one client or for everyone.
payload.longDescription:
Foodzilla是营养师、营养师和健康教练用来规划、追踪并管理其实践的营养平台。此插件将这些工作融入对话中。

向ChatGPT请求食谱，它将自动生成并计算宏量营养素成本，保存至您的资料库。请求符合卡路里和宏量营养素目标的一周膳食计划，您将获得可审核和分配的模板。通过标签或链接将食物添加至您的数据库。撰写初诊表、设置预约时段、向客户发布动态，或查看订阅状态。

您可选择是否允许客户连接。客户可让自己的助手记录膳食、饮水、锻炼、睡眠或体重，并查看当日计划。所有记录内容将进入他们的日记，供教练查阅。

您的客户数据无法通过连接访问。教练连接无法查看客户列表、客户日记、笔记或档案，也无法发送消息。它仅使用教练自身的资料：食谱、食物、膳食计划模板、资料集、表单、预约时段、内容、商店和订阅。客户连接仅能访问对应客户的档案，且无法修改教练设定的计划或目标。姓名和电子邮件地址不会进入我们的服务器日志。

您需要拥有Foodzilla账户。Foodzilla Autopilot包含在专业版及以上计划中。客户访问权限由教练控制，可针对单个客户或全体开启。

payload.name: NAFA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your NAFA account to read your workout plan and history, update an exercise, and read, log or correct food entries with calories, macros and fibre. Choose separate read and edit permissions, revoke access at any time, and confirm every change before it is saved. Biomarkers, body measurements, sensor health metrics, medical records and photos are not available through this plugin.
payload.longDescription:
将您的NAFA账户连接以查看锻炼计划和历史记录，更新运动项目，并查看、记录或更正包含卡路里、宏量营养素和膳食纤维的饮食条目。
选择独立的读取和编辑权限，随时撤销访问权限，并在保存前确认每次更改。
生物标志物、身体测量数据、传感器健康指标、医疗记录和照片无法通过此插件访问。

payload.name: Performance Signal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Performance Signal helps runners use ChatGPT to inspect their connected Strava training history, find specific activities, analyze run details and streams, compare mileage trends, and sync missing activity data into the app's private local store.
payload.longDescription: Performance Signal帮助跑步者使用ChatGPT检查连接的Strava训练历史，查找特定活动，分析跑步细节及流数据，比较里程趋势，并将缺失的活动数据同步到应用的私有本地存储。

payload.name: Conicia for OCD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Conicia is psychoeducation and self-help from an OCD specialist. Connecting it gives your AI three things: short lessons on how OCD works, in-the-moment practices called the Right Now tools that open right in the chat, and a standing request that you set by connecting: when you ask for reassurance or a re-check in an anxious loop, your AI points you to a practice instead of feeding the loop. Ordinary questions get ordinary answers. The request is yours; how your AI honours it is up to your AI, not a guarantee from Conicia.

Please read this before you connect.

Conicia is not a substitute for clinical care. It does not diagnose or treat anything, and it is not for emergencies. It is intended for adults 18 and over. A conversational AI companion may not be suitable for some minors.

Your AI can draw conclusions about you. Having an OCD tool connected, and the things you type around it, may lead your AI to infer that you have a diagnosis, whether or not that is true. Your chats stay with your AI provider under your own account and its consumer terms. They do not go to Conicia, and they are not protected the way medical records are. Use your judgment about what you share: shorthand is fine, and nothing in Conicia ever needs your story or your history. Connect it on a personal account only you can open, not a work, school, or shared one.

Conicia keeps nothing you type. Nothing you do inside a lesson or practice card is sent to Conicia or shown to your AI. There is no account and no sign-up; a tick that you finished a lesson and your place in a practice stay in your own browser only. Remove the connector any time in Settings, then Apps, for any reason. The rule, the tools, and the cards are gone from new chats immediately; conversations you already had stay in your AI's history like any other chat, so delete them there if you want them gone.
payload.longDescription:
Conicia是由强迫症专家提供的心理教育和自助工具。连接后，你的AI将获得三项功能：了解强迫症运作机制的短课程、可直接在聊天中打开的即时练习工具（称为Right Now工具），以及你通过连接设置的持续请求：当你在焦虑循环中寻求确认或反复核查时，AI会引导你进行练习，而非加剧这种循环。普通问题会得到普通回答。该请求由你自主设定；你的AI如何执行该请求取决于AI自身，并非Conicia的保证。

连接前请阅读以下内容。

Conicia不能替代专业临床护理。它不提供任何诊断或治疗，也不适用于紧急情况。本产品仅限18岁及以上成年人使用。对于部分未成年人而言，对话式AI伴侣可能并不适合。

你的AI可能基于你提供的信息做出推断。连接强迫症工具并在此周边输入的内容，可能使你的AI推断你具有相关诊断，无论该推断是否准确。你的聊天记录将保存在你的AI服务商的账户中，受其用户协议约束。这些内容不会发送至Conicia，且不会像医疗记录那样受到保护。请谨慎决定分享内容：使用简写表达是可以接受的，Conicia中的任何内容都无需你提供个人故事或过往经历。请仅在你自己独占的个人账户中连接，而非工作、学校或共享账户。

Conicia不会保存你输入的任何内容。课程或练习卡片内的任何操作都不会发送至Conicia或展示给你的AI。无需账户或注册；你完成课程的标记及练习进度仅保存在你的浏览器中。你可随时通过设置-应用菜单移除连接器，出于任何原因均可操作。新对话中将立即清除规则、工具和练习卡片；已进行的对话仍会保留在AI的历史记录中，如同其他聊天记录，如需删除请在AI端操作。

payload.name: iBody
payload.description: 在波兰寻找健身房和课程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: iBody.pl is Poland's largest database of fitness venues — 8,100+ gyms, yoga and pilates studios, dance and martial-arts schools in 100+ cities, with weekly class schedules and prices collected and refreshed automatically. Ask for any activity in any Polish city — yoga in Warsaw, reformer pilates in Krakow, crossfit in Gdansk — and get matching clubs with addresses, prices and accepted sports cards (Multisport, Medicover and more). Then pull up any club's weekly class schedule and full price list. Every result links to the club's public profile on ibody.pl, where you can see exact dates, instructors and book a class online.
payload.longDescription: iBody.pl是波兰最大的健身场所数据库——涵盖8100多家健身房、瑜伽和普拉提工作室、舞蹈及武术学校，覆盖100多个城市，每周课程安排和价格会自动收集和更新。在任何波兰城市查询任何活动——华沙的瑜伽课程、克拉科夫的普拉提课程、格但斯克的Crossfit课程——即可获得匹配的俱乐部信息，包含地址、价格及支持的运动卡（Multisport、Medicover等）。查看任意俱乐部的每周课程表和完整价目表。每个搜索结果都会链接到该俱乐部在ibody.pl上的公开资料页，您可以在那里查看具体日期、教练信息并在线报名课程。

payload.name: Running Workout
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Running Workout is a sports training assistant for runners, cyclists and swimmers who train with a Garmin watch. It reads the athlete's own Garmin activities and training profile, keeps track of race goals and training plans, and builds structured running, cycling and swimming workouts that it schedules on the athlete's Garmin Connect calendar, so they sync to the watch. It connects through the official Garmin Connect Developer Program API with the athlete's consent and only accesses the connected account. It is a sports training tool and does not give medical advice.
payload.longDescription: Running Workout 是一款针对使用 Garmin 手表的跑步、骑行和游泳运动员的运动训练助手。它可读取运动员的 Garmin 活动记录和训练档案，跟踪比赛目标与训练计划，并生成结构化的跑步、骑行和游泳训练方案，从而同步到运动员的 Garmin Connect 日历，最终同步到手表。该应用通过官方 Garmin Connect 开发者计划 API 连接，需获得运动员授权后仅访问已连接账户。它是一款运动训练工具，不提供医疗建议。

payload.name: Capital Health
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search the Capital Health sports nutrition catalog, compare current prices in Russian rubles, review product details and alternatives, and build a shopping list. Choose a delivery region, confirm items and quantities, then open a 24-hour link to sign in to Capital Health, import the list into the cart, and complete checkout. Capital Health sells physical goods. The plugin does not provide medical advice, store customer accounts or payment details, reserve stock, or lock prices.
payload.longDescription: 搜索Capital Health运动营养品目录，以俄罗斯卢布查看当前价格，查看产品详情及替代品并创建购物清单。选择配送区域，确认商品和数量后，通过24小时链接登录Capital Health，将清单导入购物车并完成结账。Capital Health销售实体商品。该插件不提供医疗建议、不存储客户账户或支付信息、不预留库存或锁定价格。

payload.name: Athlete Space
payload.description: 适用于任何运动的训练计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Athlete Space builds a full training plan inside the chat. For a goal race from 5K to marathon it writes every week and every run, sets training paces from a recent race or your easy pace, and predicts your race times. If you miss sessions, it rebuilds the plan around them. For triathlon (sprint to Ironman), HYROX, cycling, CrossFit, swimming, and running with strength, it builds a season: phases, hours for each week, and the sessions of the first weeks and the peak week, sized to the hours you have. No account is needed and nothing is saved. Each plan comes with a link that opens the same plan on athletespace.ai, where you can save it and sync it to your watch.
payload.longDescription: Athlete Space在聊天中构建完整的训练计划。针对从5K到马拉松的赛事目标，它会规划每周的训练内容和每次跑步，根据最近的比赛成绩或你的轻松配速设定训练配速，并预测你的比赛时间。如果错过训练课程，它会重新调整计划。针对铁人三项（从短距离到铁人三项）、HYROX、骑行、CrossFit、游泳和力量训练跑步，它会制定整个赛季的计划：包括各个阶段、每周的时长，以及前几周和巅峰周的训练内容，根据你可用的时长进行调整。无需账户，且不会保存任何内容。每个计划都会附带一个链接，点击后可在athletespace.ai打开相同的计划，您可以保存并同步到智能手表上。

payload.name: Clynevia Booking
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Clynevia Booking is an appointment booking tool for nutrition and dietitian clinics. It lets you book a visit at a clinic that uses Clynevia, without leaving the conversation. It only handles appointments: it does not give medical or nutrition advice.

Tell ChatGPT the clinic's name or paste its booking link. It shows the clinic's real free times, asks for your name and WhatsApp number, reads the booking back to you, and places it only after you say yes. You get a booking code to keep: with the code and your phone number you can check, cancel or move the booking later, from any conversation.

Every booking is a request. The clinic's specialist confirms the time with you; nothing is confirmed automatically.

What it collects: your name and phone number, and only when you book. It does not ask about your health. If the clinic wants a form filled before your visit, you get a link to fill it on the clinic's own page.

Only clinics that have switched this on can be booked, and only clinics that chose to be listed can be found by name. It works in Arabic and English.
payload.longDescription:
Clynevia Booking是面向营养和营养师诊所的预约工具，可让您在无需离开对话界面的情况下，于使用Clynevia的诊所预约就诊。该工具仅处理预约事务：不提供医疗或营养建议。

告诉ChatGPT诊所名称或粘贴其预约链接，它将显示诊所的真实空闲时段，询问您的姓名和WhatsApp号码，向您确认预约信息，并在您确认后才完成预约。您将获得一个预约验证码：凭此验证码和手机号码，可随时通过任意对话界面查看、取消或修改预约。

每次预约都需人工确认，诊所的专业人员会与您核实时间，系统不会自动确认任何预约。

收集的信息包括您的姓名和手机号码，且仅在预约时收集。不会询问健康状况，若诊所要求预约前填写表格，您将收到跳转至诊所独立页面的链接。

仅限已开启此功能的诊所可被预约，仅限选择公开列表的诊所可通过名称搜索。支持阿拉伯语和英语两种语言。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find a nutrition clinic by name or booking link, See a clinic's free appointment times, Place a booking request that the clinic confirms, Check, cancel or move a booking with its code and phone number

payload.name: FormBlends Companion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calculate peptide concentration and convert mg, mcg, mL and syringe units from values you provide. Create a weekly meal and workout plan, organize a grocery list, and save your calculations and plans. Reopen your saved week and record completed activities. FormBlends brings peptide measurement tools, meal planning and workout organization into ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
根据您提供的数值计算肽类浓度，并将毫克、微克、毫升和注射器单位进行转换。
创建每周饮食和锻炼计划，整理购物清单，并保存您的计算结果和计划。
重新打开已保存的周计划并记录已完成的活动。
FormBlends将肽类测量工具、饮食规划和锻炼管理整合到ChatGPT中。

payload.name: Alkemy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Alkemy is a fitness and strength training app. Coaches plan workouts for their athletes, and athletes log what they did.

Connect your Alkemy athlete account to ask about today's workout, look back at your training, and check your progress. Tell ChatGPT what you did, and it logs the workout or the run for you, so your coach sees it in Alkemy.

You need an Alkemy athlete account: your coach invites you. ChatGPT can only read and log your own training. It cannot see your injuries, bodyweight or payment details, and you can disconnect it at any time in Alkemy under Profile, Connected apps.

Alkemy is a training tool. It does not give medical advice.
payload.longDescription:
Alkemy是一款健身和力量训练应用。教练为学员制定训练计划，学员记录自己完成的内容。

连接您的Alkemy学员账户可查询当日训练内容、回顾训练记录并查看进度。告诉ChatGPT您完成了什么，它会为您记录训练或跑步内容，您的教练即可在Alkemy中看到。

您需要拥有Alkemy学员账户：您的教练会邀请您。ChatGPT只能读取和记录您自己的训练数据，无法查看您的伤病信息、体重或支付详情，您可在Alkemy的「个人资料-已连接应用」中随时断开连接。

Alkemy是一款训练工具，不提供医疗建议。

payload.name: Infinite State
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Infinite State recommends meditation listening sessions for adults seeking everyday wellness routines: relaxing when stressed, winding down at bedtime, or concentrating during work or study. Describe your immediate goal in a short request. The plugin maps that request to Stress, Sleep, or Focus and returns one selected binaural-beat session, its title, duration, a concise explanation, and a direct Infinite State listening link. The catalog contains three fixed sessions: Stress (11:11), Sleep (55:55), and Focus (22:22). Requests do not change session lengths, and audio plays on Infinite State rather than inside ChatGPT. This is a general-wellness recommendation service, not a clinical service: it does not diagnose conditions, recommend medical treatments, or promise health outcomes.
payload.longDescription: Infinite State为寻求日常健康习惯的成年人推荐冥想聆听课程：在压力下放松、睡前舒缓或工作学习时专注。用简短的请求描述您的即时目标。该插件会将请求匹配至压力缓解、睡眠或专注模式，并返回一个选定的双耳节拍课程、课程标题、时长、简要说明和直接进入Infinite State的聆听链接。课程库包含三个固定时长的课程：压力缓解（11:11）、睡眠（55:55）和专注（22:22）。请求不会改变课程时长，音频将在Infinite State平台播放而非ChatGPT内部播放。此为通用健康建议服务，非临床诊疗服务：不提供疾病诊断、医疗建议或承诺健康效果。

payload.name: ARVO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ARVO connects a user's private workout plan and training history to ChatGPT. Users can review today's session, their active split, recent workouts, personal records, exercise progression, volume, and coaching insights; start workouts; log sets; adapt exercises; update training preferences; and generate personalized workouts. ARVO is a fitness tool and does not provide medical advice.
payload.longDescription: ARVO将用户的私人训练计划和训练历史连接至ChatGPT。用户可查看今日课程、活跃的训练分割、近期训练记录、个人最佳成绩、运动进展、训练总量及教练洞察；开始训练；记录组数；调整训练动作；更新训练偏好；并生成个性化训练计划。ARVO是一款健身工具，不提供医疗建议。

payload.name: D-Fit
payload.description: 你的饮食日记，就在聊天中
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your D-Fit account to log meals and water, correct portions, and review daily calories, macros and seven-day summaries. Describe food or attach a photo in ChatGPT, review estimated portions, and save to the same diary you use in D-Fit. Photo nutrition is an estimate; original photos are not copied to D-Fit by this integration. Sign-in and explicit account permission are required. D-Fit provides nutrition tracking, not medical diagnosis or treatment.
payload.longDescription:
连接您的D-Fit账户以记录餐食和饮水，修正分量，并查看每日卡路里、宏量营养素和七日总结。
在ChatGPT中描述食物或上传照片，查看估算的分量，并保存到您在D-Fit中使用的同一本日记中。
照片营养估算为参考值；此集成不会将原始照片复制到D-Fit。
需要登录并授予明确的账户权限。
D-Fit提供营养追踪功能，不提供医疗诊断或治疗。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read diary, Review meals, Log meals and water

payload.name: Coach to Wrist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Coach to Wrist is a training platform for structured workouts: sessions are built block by block, run on a smartwatch or phone, and the results come back automatically, planned vs performed.

It works for two kinds of people:
- Coaches plan sessions for the athletes they follow. ChatGPT drafts the workout; the coach saves it to their library or puts it on an athlete's calendar.
- Athletes can also train on their own, with or without a coach: ChatGPT drafts the workout and it goes straight to their own calendar, ready to run.

With this app, ChatGPT can:
- Create workout drafts. Describe a session (running intervals, strength sets, hybrid or ergometer work, rest and loops) and ChatGPT turns it into a structured workout in your account. Nothing is saved until you open the link ChatGPT gives you and confirm the draft in the app; mention a day ("for tomorrow") and the calendar opens on that day.
- Analyse your own training. If you allow it, ChatGPT can read the sessions you completed: planned vs performed per block, heart rate, pace, loads, session RPE and readiness. Use it to spot trends, review a hard week or plan the next one.

Your data stays under your control. ChatGPT only ever reads your own training data, never other athletes' data, even if you are a coach. Reading requires a separate, revocable consent you give when connecting or from your Profile, and every read is logged. Sharing is unavailable to users under 14.

New to Coach to Wrist? Create your account while connecting: choose whether you are a coach or an athlete, and finish your profile later in the app.
payload.longDescription:
Coach to Wrist是结构化训练的平台：训练课程按模块逐个构建，通过智能手表或手机运行，结果会自动返回显示计划与实际执行的对比

该平台适用于两类用户：
- 教练可以为所指导的运动员规划课程。
ChatGPT生成训练计划；教练可将其保存到自己的资料库或添加到运动员的日历中。
- 运动员也可自主训练，是否配有教练均可：ChatGPT生成训练计划后直接发送至个人日历，随时可开始训练。

通过该应用，ChatGPT可以：
- 创建训练草案。
描述一个训练单元（跑步间歇、力量训练组数、混合训练或划船机训练、休息与循环训练），ChatGPT会将其转化为账户中的结构化训练方案。
在您打开ChatGPT提供的链接并在应用中确认草案前，所有内容不会被保存；指定日期（“明天”）后日历会自动跳转至该日期。
- 分析自身训练数据。
如果您授权，ChatGPT可读取已完成的训练单元：每个模块的计划与执行对比、心率、配速、负荷量、训练量感受（RPE）和身体准备度。
可用于发现趋势、复盘高强度周或规划下一周训练。

您的数据始终由您掌控。
ChatGPT仅读取您自己的训练数据，即使您是教练也不会访问其他运动员的数据。
读取操作需要单独的、可撤销的授权，该授权可在连接时提供或从个人资料中设置，每次读取操作都会被记录。
14岁以下用户无法使用共享功能。

首次使用Coach to Wrist？
在连接时创建账户：选择您是教练还是运动员，并稍后在应用中完善个人资料。

payload.name: Lila Meals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan practical meals with Lila’s recipe library. Find recipes by ingredients, cooking time and food preferences, adjust household servings, swap individual meals, and create a consolidated shopping list with pantry staples. Nutrition values are estimates. General cooking guidance; no Lila account is required.
payload.longDescription: 通过Lila的食谱库规划实用餐食。根据食材、烹饪时间和饮食偏好查找食谱，调整家庭份量，替换单餐内容，并生成包含常备食材的整合购物清单。营养数据为估算值，提供通用烹饪指导；无需Lila账户

payload.name: Liftory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Liftory is a training and nutrition coaching app for athletes, personal trainers and nutrition coaches. Connect your Liftory account to plan training and nutrition, follow your workouts and coach your clients from ChatGPT.

For athletes:
- Create a training plan from a plain description (for example "a 3-day full-body plan for my home gym"), using Liftory's exercise catalog in five languages.
- Build a nutrition plan from your targets and food preferences.
- Review your current training and nutrition plans and your recent workouts.
- Read and answer messages from your coach.

For personal trainers and nutrition coaches:
- See the clients you coach, with their activity and adherence.
- Create and review training and nutrition plans for a client, or digitize them from a document or a picture.
- Read and answer client conversations.

In Codex, a coach can work through client conversations like an inbox (summarize what is waiting, draft replies, send them once approved) and have training and nutrition plans drafted for clients, reviewed and saved in one session.

You stay in control: you sign in with your own Liftory account and approve the connection on Liftory's consent page, the assistant asks before every change (creating a plan, activating a menu, sending a message), and a coach can only reach clients who currently grant them coaching access. You can disconnect at any time in the Liftory app under Settings, Connected assistants.
payload.longDescription:

针对运动员：

payload.name: Fitless
payload.description: 健身房与居家锻炼计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fitless is a fitness and exercise plugin: its main purpose is to build a personalized weekly workout plan for the gym or for home, right in the chat, and to show how to do every exercise with an animated demo. It is for physical training only, not for medical care. Use it when you want a training plan, a workout routine, a gym split, a home workout, a strength or weight training program, a muscle-building (hypertrophy), fat-loss or conditioning plan, or to learn how to do an exercise with good form.

How it works:

If something is missing, a short quiz opens in the Fitless card.
- Fitless picks every exercise from its own catalog of 249 exercises and gives sets, reps, rest and an animated demo for each one. Each day is sized to the session length you asked for, and the plan follows sex-specific exercise rules.
- If you mention pain in your back, knees, shoulders, neck, elbows, feet or hips, you pick the region privately in the card, after an explicit consent, and the plan leaves out exercises that strain it. The region is never sent to the model.
- Ask how to do any exercise, such as a Romanian deadlift, a squat or a lat pulldown, and Fitless shows its demo and step-by-step instructions.
- Save the plan to a Fitless account in one tap and train with the Fitless app: rest timer, load logging and automatic progression.

Kalori is a nutrition catalog for Japanese convenience stores and restaurant chains. It covers 380+ chains (Seven-Eleven, Lawson, FamilyMart, Saizeriya, Sukiya, McDonald's Japan and more) and returns calories and protein, fat, and carbohydrates for their items. Data is refreshed nightly from official chain sources, and every item carries a nutritionSource marker: official means the chain publishes the value, partial means published values completed with AI estimates, and estimated means every value is AI-estimated.

A linked Kalori account is required. Personal-record features are available according to the linked account's existing access, and usage limits apply. The plugin does not offer purchases or subscription management.

Main workflows: (1) find something to eat at a specific chain under a nutrition constraint, for example high-protein and under 500 kcal at Seven-Eleven; (2) look up several dishes in one call when planning a meal or a shopping list; (3) compose a meal from catalog items and render it as a meal-plan card whose totals are computed server-side from catalog values, so the numbers shown are not model estimates; (4) log what was eaten and see the day's remaining budget.

Search terms, filters, and result counts are retained as the linked account's search history to improve catalog coverage; each call also records the IP address and user-agent in private operational logs that are deleted automatically after about seven days. The tools accept no precise location, chat transcripts, or third-party account identifiers, and personal records are only ever reached through the user's own linked account.

搜索关键词、筛选条件和结果数量会作为搜索历史保存以优化目录覆盖范围；每次操作还会在私有操作日志中记录IP地址和用户代理信息，约七天后自动清除。工具不收集精确位置、聊天记录或第三方账户标识，个人记录仅可通过用户自身的绑定账户访问。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Filter results by calorie range and by protein, fat, or carbohydrate range, Look up several dishes in a single call when planning a meal or a shopping list, Rank results by how well they fit a calorie or PFC target, List every supported chain with the id used for filtering, Re-fetch the exact nutrition of a single catalog item by id, Render a meal-plan card whose totals are computed server-side from catalog values, Label every value as published by the chain, partially estimated, or fully estimated, Log meals from catalog items or from a description, Review a day's totals against personal calorie and PFC targets, Update goals and record weight and exercise

payload.name: ATHLO
payload.description: 找到适合您的健康生活方式
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover wellness and fitness sessions and venues with ATHLO. Search by location, date, time and category, including yoga, Pilates, martial arts, gym access and heat-based wellness. Compare returned schedules, locations, prices and catalog availability, and inspect session and venue details. Follow result links to the ATHLO app to check booking eligibility and complete your booking. This plugin provides read-only discovery, booking and payments must be completed in the ATHLO app.
payload.longDescription: 通过ATHLO发现健康与健身课程及场所。按地点、日期、时间和类别（包括瑜伽、普拉提、武术、健身房入场和热疗健康）进行搜索。比较返回的日程、地点、价格和目录库存，并查看课程和场所详情。通过结果链接跳转至ATHLO应用，查看预订资格并完成预订。此插件仅提供只读发现功能，预订和支付必须在ATHLO应用中完成。

payload.name: PepScribe Half-Life
payload.description: 药物半衰期随时间的变化
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PepScribe Half-Life shows how much of a medication or supplement remains in the body over time from its elimination half-life. Give the half-life in hours (from the product's published information) and, if you like, the dose and the time between doses. It draws the levels over time, tells you how long until about 97% is cleared (five half-lives), how much is left after a day and after a week, and for repeated doses how levels build up and when they reach steady state.

The result is a card with a curve that draws in, half-life markers after the last dose, a steady-state band for repeated doses, and a scrubber you can drag or step with the arrow keys to read any moment.

PepScribe Half-Life uses a simplified one-compartment model for education; real levels vary with the person, the formulation and absorption. It does not suggest a dose, a dosing interval, or when it is safe to take something else. The numbers you enter are used to draw the chart and are not stored.
payload.longDescription:
PepScribe Half-Life 通过消除半衰期展示药物或补充剂在体内随时间推移的残留量。输入半衰期（以小时为单位，来自产品公开信息），如果需要，还可输入剂量和服药间隔。该工具会绘制随时间变化的浓度曲线，显示约97%被清除所需时间（五个半衰期）、一天后和一周后剩余量，以及重复给药时浓度如何累积并在何时达到稳态。

结果会生成一张卡片，包含浓度曲线、最后一次服药后的半衰期标记、重复给药的稳态带，以及可拖动或用箭头键逐步调整的滑块，用于查看任意时间点的数据。

PepScribe Half-Life 使用简化的一室模型进行教学演示；实际浓度会因个体差异、制剂配方和吸收情况而不同。它不提供用药建议、给药间隔建议或与其他药物同时使用的安全性判断。您输入的数据仅用于绘制图表，不会被存储。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Levels-over-time chart, Time until about 97% cleared, Build-up and steady state for repeated doses, Read any moment on the curve

payload.name: AI Calorie Counter by BodyPal
payload.description: 追踪卡路里和宏量营养素
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AI Calorie Counter by BodyPal is a free AI calorie counter and calorie tracker for ChatGPT. Type what you ate or share a photo of your meal and get the calories, protein, carbs and fat in seconds.

Describe your food in your own words: by weight ("150 g chicken breast"), by count ("2 eggs, a banana") or by portion ("a bowl of rice, a tablespoon of olive oil"). ChatGPT identifies the foods and amounts, and BodyPal looks each one up in its food calorie database (USDA data and product labels).

You get a clear nutrition card: total calories and macros, fiber, sugar and salt, plus a line for every food with its photo, weight and calories. Add your daily calorie goal and the card shows how many calories you have left today, which helps with weight loss, a calorie deficit or muscle gain.

Use it as a macro and calorie tracker for one meal, a recipe or a whole day, in 19 languages, with no account and no sign-in. Values are estimates for information only and are not medical advice.
payload.longDescription:
AI卡路里计数器 by BodyPal 是专为 ChatGPT 设计的免费 AI 卡路里计数器和追踪工具。输入你吃了什么或分享餐食照片，即可在几秒钟内获取卡路里、蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪含量。

用你自己的语言描述食物：按重量（"150 克鸡胸肉"）、按数量（"2 个鸡蛋、一根香蕉"）或按分量（"一碗米饭、一汤匙橄榄油"）。ChatGPT 会识别食物和分量，然后 BodyPal 会将其逐一查询其食品卡路里数据库（USDA 数据和产品标签）。

您将获得一份清晰的营养卡：总卡路里和宏量营养素、膳食纤维、糖分和盐分，以及每种食物的图片、重量和卡路里明细。设置每日卡路里目标后，该卡片会显示您今天剩余的卡路里数，有助于减脂、制造热量赤字或增肌。

可在 19 种语言中使用该工具追踪单餐、食谱或全天的宏量营养素和卡路里，无需账户和登录。数值仅为估算信息，不构成医疗建议。

payload.name: PepScribe Pharmacy Check
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PepScribe Pharmacy Check helps you judge whether an online pharmacy, telehealth service or website selling prescription or compounded medication looks safe to buy from. Answer what you know about the seller: whether it requires a prescription, whether a licensed clinician reviews you, which pharmacy fills the order and whether its license checks out, and the common warning signs such as a research use only label or shipping from outside the US. It scores the answers against the FDA's BeSafeRx signs of a safe online pharmacy and returns a verdict, the warning signs and what to verify.

The card shows the verdict and score, each sign with yes, no or not sure controls you can change to update the check, and links to the FDA BeSafeRx guide, NABP Safe Pharmacy, your state board of pharmacy and the LegitScript certification check.

PepScribe Pharmacy Check never names, ranks or recommends sellers, and it cannot confirm a license itself; always verify it on the official sites. Your answers are used to compute the check and are not stored.
payload.longDescription:
PepScribe Pharmacy Check能帮助您判断在线药店、远程医疗服务平台或销售处方药及定制药物的网站是否值得购买。回答您对卖家的了解：是否需要处方、是否有持牌临床医生审核、由哪家药店配药以及其执照是否有效，并识别常见警示标志，例如仅限研究使用标签或从美国境外发货。它会根据FDA的BeSafeRx安全在线药店标志对答案进行评分，并返回结论、警示标志及需验证的信息。

该卡片显示结论和评分，每个标志都配有可更改的“是”“否”或“不确定”控制选项以更新检查结果，并提供FDA BeSafeRx指南、NABP安全药店、您所在州药房委员会及LegitScript认证检查的链接。

PepScribe Pharmacy Check不会对卖家进行命名、排名或推荐，也无法自行确认执照有效性；请始终通过官方网站进行核实。您的回答仅用于计算检查结果，不会被存储。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Verdict and score from the FDA BeSafeRx signs, Warning signs a seller shows, Change answers in the card, Links to official license lookups

payload.name: StrengthLog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StrengthLog helps you analyze the strength-training data you have logged in your StrengthLog account. Summarize workouts over a date range, inspect individual sessions and sets, review personal records, and retrieve logged body measurements. Filter workout history and summaries by exercise using English or Swedish exercise names. Sign in with your StrengthLog account to explore your own training history in conversation. The connection provides read-only access and cannot create, modify, or delete workouts or other account data.
payload.longDescription:
StrengthLog可帮助您分析在StrengthLog账户中记录的力量训练数据。
在指定日期范围内总结训练内容，检查单次训练和组数，查看个人最佳记录，并获取已记录的身体测量数据。
可通过使用英文或瑞典语的练习名称筛选训练历史记录和摘要。
通过StrengthLog账户登录，即可以对话方式探索您的训练历史。
该连接仅提供只读访问权限，无法创建、修改或删除训练计划或其他账户数据。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Summarize training history, View workout sessions and sets, View personal records, View body measurements

payload.name: Zelta Protein Per Day
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Works out a daily protein range in grams from body weight and goal (maintain, weight loss or muscle gain) using ICMR-NIN and published sports-nutrition ranges, and builds a sample day from common Indian foods such as dal, paneer, curd, soya, eggs and chicken to reach it. Estimates only, not medical advice. Outbound links carry campaign tags identifying ChatGPT as the source.
payload.longDescription: 根据体重和目标（维持、减重或增肌）计算每日蛋白质摄入范围（克），采用ICMR-NIN及已发表的运动营养标准，结合常见印度食物如豆类、奶酪、酸奶、大豆、鸡蛋和鸡肉，制定达到目标的示例饮食计划。仅作估算，不构成医疗建议。外部链接会带有标识ChatGPT为来源的营销跟踪标签。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Protein per day, Sample Indian protein day

payload.name: CostKits Procedure Costs
payload.description: 美国常见医疗程序费用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find out what common medical procedures typically cost in your state before you book. Ask about a colonoscopy, MRI, knee replacement, sleep study and more, and get a typical price range (low, median, high), what the price usually includes, and facilities near you that perform it, drawn from public hospital price transparency data and Medicare data. Results are estimates of typical allowed amounts, not quotes. Your actual price depends on your insurance, the facility and your plan's deductible and coinsurance. Facility lists show up to five places per request and do not include dollar prices. CostKits gives general information and estimates, not medical, legal, tax or financial advice. Do not enter names, member numbers or medical records.
payload.longDescription: 在预订前了解您所在州常见医疗程序的费用。询问结肠镜检查、磁共振成像（MRI）、膝盖置换手术、睡眠研究等项目，可获取典型价格范围（低、中位数、高）、价格通常包含的内容，以及您附近提供该服务的医疗机构信息，数据来源于公立医院价格透明数据和医疗保险数据。结果为典型允许金额的估算值，而非具体报价。您的实际价格取决于保险类型、医疗机构以及计划的免赔额和共付比例。机构列表每项请求最多显示五个地点，且不包含美元价格。CostKits提供一般信息和估算，不提供医疗、法律、税务或财务建议。请勿输入姓名、会员号码或医疗记录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Estimate procedure costs by state, Show cost ranges (low, median, high), Explain what is in a procedure price, Find facilities that perform a procedure, Look up a provider by NPI

payload.name: Zelta Daily Calorie Target
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Estimates maintenance calories with the Mifflin-St Jeor formula and an activity level, then a daily calorie target for a chosen weekly weight-loss pace with safety rails: never below 1,200 kcal for women or 1,500 kcal for men, and no faster than 1% of body weight a week. Also estimates how many weeks a weight goal takes at a daily calorie deficit. Estimates only, not medical advice. Outbound links carry campaign tags identifying ChatGPT as the source.
payload.longDescription: 通过Mifflin-St Jeor公式和活动水平估算维持热量，再根据选定的每周减重速度设定每日卡路里目标，并设置安全限制：女性每日不低于1200千卡、男性每日不低于1500千卡，且每周减重速度不超过体重的1%。同时估算在每日热量赤字状态下达成体重目标所需的周数。以上仅为估算结果，不构成医疗建议。外部链接会带有标识ChatGPT来源的跟踪标签。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Daily calorie target, Weight goal timeline

payload.name: Lion Lift
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use your Lion Lift workout history to plan runs, pool swims, bike rides, and lifts; review progress across sports; compare planned and completed sessions; and create training reports.
payload.longDescription: 利用你的Lion Lift健身记录来规划跑步、游泳、骑车和力量训练；跨运动项目查看进度；对比计划与完成的训练课程；并生成训练报告。

payload.name: Zelta Steps to Calories
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Estimates calories burned, distance and time for a step count from body weight and walking pace, using METs from the Compendium of Physical Activities. Also works out how many steps it takes to walk off a calorie amount or a common Indian food such as a roti, samosa, katori of rice or dal. Estimates only, not medical advice. Outbound links carry campaign tags identifying ChatGPT as the source.
payload.longDescription: 根据体重和步行速度，估算步数对应的消耗卡路里、距离和时间，使用《体力活动能量当量表》中的代谢当量（METs）值。也能计算需要多少步才能消耗掉特定卡路里数或常见印度食物（如烤薄饼、炸饺、一碗米饭或扁豆）的热量。以上估算仅供参考，不构成医疗建议。外部链接会带有标识ChatGPT为来源的营销标签。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Calories burned by steps, Steps to walk off a food

payload.name: Zelta BMI for Indians
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calculates adult BMI from height and weight and shows the category under the Asian-Indian consensus cutoffs, where overweight starts at 23 and obesity at 25, next to the international WHO categories. Also gives the weight range that sits in the normal band for a given height. Screening numbers only, not a diagnosis. Outbound links carry campaign tags identifying ChatGPT as the source.
payload.longDescription: 根据身高和体重计算成人BMI，并显示在亚洲印度共识标准下的分类。该标准中超重起始值为23，肥胖起始值为25，同时展示国际WHO标准。还提供特定身高对应的正常体重范围。仅用于筛查，不构成诊断。外链会带有标识ChatGPT为来源的跟踪标签。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: BMI check (Indian cutoffs), Healthy weight range for a height

payload.name: Boulie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan and review your cycling and running training with Boulie in ChatGPT.

Connect your Boulie account to view your training plan and goals, prepare structured workouts with calculated targets, and save plan changes after you confirm them. Record completed-session reviews and keep your training plan and coaching record connected across conversations.

Boulie supports daily workouts and longer-term training blocks around your goals and schedule. Your saved workouts are available in the Boulie app to follow.

A Boulie account is required. Boulie provides fitness training guidance, not medical advice.
payload.longDescription:
通过ChatGPT中的Boulie规划并回顾您的骑行和跑步训练。

连接您的Boulie账户可查看训练计划与目标，制定包含计算目标值的结构化训练，并在确认后保存计划修改。记录已完成的训练回顾内容，确保训练计划与教练记录在对话中持续同步。

Boulie支持围绕您的目标和日程安排的日常训练及长期训练周期，您保存的训练计划可在Boulie应用中查看并执行。

需要Boulie账户，Boulie提供健身训练指导，而非医疗建议。

payload.name: ClinMatch
payload.description: 监督下的牙科清洁服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ClinMatch helps people find dental and dental hygiene care at supervised training clinics when they explicitly ask for dental or dental hygiene care, an appointment, or a cleaning — not for symptoms, emergencies, or unrelated requests. Use this plugin in ChatGPT to search public listings by city, region, or country, review what each listing offers, and open the ClinMatch website to request an appointment.

The integration is read-only: it searches and shows listing details but does not create ClinMatch accounts, book visits, or collect personal information inside ChatGPT. Appointment requests happen on clinmatch.io using each listing's request page.

Care shown on ClinMatch is provided in supervised clinical training settings. Listing details, supervision notes, and scheduling steps come from each program's published listing.
payload.longDescription:
当用户明确要求牙科护理、牙科卫生护理、预约或清洁时，ClinMatch会帮助人们在监督培训诊所中找到相关服务——不适用于症状描述、紧急情况或无关请求。
在ChatGPT中使用此插件可通过城市、地区或国家搜索公开列表，查看每个列表提供的服务内容，并打开ClinMatch网站申请预约。

该集成仅支持只读操作：可在ChatGPT中搜索并查看列表详情，但无法在系统内创建ClinMatch账户、预订就诊或收集个人信息。
所有预约申请需通过clinmatch.io网站，使用各列表页提供的预约页面完成。

ClinMatch展示的护理服务均在监督临床培训环境中提供。
列表详情、监督备注及排班步骤均来自各项目官方发布的信息。

payload.name: Prizm
payload.longDescription:
Prizm是一款耐力训练教练，涵盖跑步、骑行、游泳和铁人三项。该连接器可让ChatGPT在你向它询问训练相关问题时，读取你的Prizm数据。

你通过Prizm账户进行连接。ChatGPT仅能访问你的个人数据，绝不会接触其他运动员的数据。

ChatGPT可读取的内容包括：

· 当日身体状态：身体状况、疲劳度、精神状态、恢复情况；
· 你的训练区间与阈值：功能性阈值功率（FTP）、最大摄氧量（VMA）、配速、临界速度（CSS）、心率；
· 已计划的训练课程，以及每周计划与实际完成情况对比；
· 最近的训练记录，以及其中某次训练的详细分析；
· 当前赛季情况、即将参加的比赛、性能报告；
· 教练提供的训练建议。

该连接器为只读模式：不会修改、删除或安排你的Prizm账户中的任何内容。它不连接任何运动手表或厂商账户，这些连接需在你的Prizm账户内完成。

健康数据（睡眠质量、心率变异性、恢复状态、心率）仅在你于Prizm中明确授权后才会被读取。Prizm数据托管在巴黎，ChatGPT对这些数据的后续处理遵循OpenAI的隐私政策。

训练区间与阈值数据由Prizm计算生成：连接器会要求助手直接引用这些数据，而非重新计算。

payload.name: Oasis Health
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use Oasis Health when someone asks which packaged food, drink, supplement, or personal-care product is healthier, names a brand or barcode, or asks what lab tests show. It searches the Oasis catalog, returns the published score, explains that score, and shows published lab evidence and same-category alternatives.

Oasis Health is read-only. It does not buy products, change accounts, or give a personal medical diagnosis. It does not treat a missing test as “not detected,” and it does not rank tap water against bottled water.
payload.longDescription:
当有人询问哪种包装食品、饮料、补充剂或个人护理产品更健康，提及品牌或条形码，或询问实验室检测结果时，请使用Oasis Health。它会搜索Oasis目录，返回已发布的评分，解释该评分，并展示已发布的实验室证据及同类别替代品。

Oasis Health为只读模式。它不会购买产品、修改账户或提供个人医疗诊断。它不会将缺失的检测视为「未检测到」，也不会将自来水与瓶装水进行比较。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search packaged products, Explain Oasis scores, Show published lab evidence, Compare products in one category, Find healthier alternatives

payload.name: Eating Buddy
payload.description: 关于你的饮食日志的提问
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Eating Buddy is a mindful eating journal for iPhone and Android. Connect it to ask ChatGPT about what you logged: meals and the foods in them, hunger before and fullness after eating, mindfulness, places and reasons, drinks and water, sleep, moods, cravings check-ins and workouts.

Ask for a plain list ("What did I eat yesterday?") or for patterns ("Do I snack more after short nights?", "Which foods do I eat most often?", "How did my mood compare on the days I worked out?"). ChatGPT reads only your own entries, as your account; it cannot change or delete anything.

Connecting takes a minute: ChatGPT shows a six-digit code, you type it in the Eating Buddy app under Settings, AI assistants, and approve. You can unlink it any time from the same screen. Eating Buddy describes what your journal shows; it does not give diet plans or medical advice.
payload.longDescription:
Eating Buddy是专为iPhone和Android设计的正念饮食日志。将其连接后可向ChatGPT咨询你的记录内容：包括餐食及其中的食物、进食前的饥饿感与进食后的饱腹感、正念状态、用餐地点与原因、饮品与饮水情况、睡眠质量、情绪状态、渴望检查以及运动记录。

可请求获取纯文本清单（「我昨天吃了什么？」）或分析规律（「睡眠时间短的日子我是否更容易吃零食？」、「我最常吃哪些食物？」、「锻炼的日子我的情绪状况如何？」）。ChatGPT仅读取您账户中的个人记录，无法更改或删除任何内容。

连接过程仅需一分钟：ChatGPT会显示六位数字验证码，您在Eating Buddy应用的「设置-人工智能助手」页面输入该验证码并确认即可。您可随时从同一界面断开连接。Eating Buddy仅会描述日志内容，不提供饮食方案或医疗建议。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read your meals and the foods in them, Read hunger, fullness and mindfulness per meal, Read drinks and water intake, Read sleep sessions, Read moods and cravings check-ins, Read workouts, Answer pattern questions with read-only SQL over your journal

payload.name: Food Tracker
payload.description: 记录餐食并查看剩余量
payload.summaryOriginal: Log meals and see what's left
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Food Tracker is a personal nutrition log you keep by talking to ChatGPT. Send a photo of your plate, a voice note or a sentence like "two idlis and sambar for breakfast"; ChatGPT works out each item's portion, calories, protein, carbs, fat, fibre and key vitamins and minerals, shows you the list, and records it once you agree. Ask "how much protein is left today?" or "how did I do this week?" and it reads your log back.

It also keeps your weight and body-composition readings (including photos of smart-scale printouts), steps and workouts, your meal plan and your daily and per-meal targets, which it can suggest from your goal and pace. Everything is also visible at foodtracker.in.

For adults who want to track what they eat without typing into an app. Figures are estimates, not medical advice. You need a Food Tracker account; you sign in and approve access when you connect.
payload.longDescription:
Food Tracker 是一款通过与 ChatGPT 对话来记录个人营养数据的工具。发送餐盘照片、语音备忘录或类似「早餐吃了两个 idlis 和 sambar」的句子；ChatGPT 会计算每种食物的分量、卡路里、蛋白质、碳水化合物、脂肪、纤维及关键维生素和矿物质，展示清单并在你确认后记录数据。询问「今天还剩多少蛋白质？」或「这周表现如何？」即可回顾你的饮食记录。

它还会记录你的体重和体成分数据（包括智能秤测量结果的照片）、步数和锻炼情况、饮食计划以及每日和每餐的目标，这些目标可根据你的目标和进度进行建议。所有数据也可在 foodtracker.in 查看。

适合希望记录饮食却无需在应用中输入文字的成年人。数据为估算值，不是医疗建议。你需要拥有 Food Tracker 账户；连接时需登录并批准访问权限。

information.value: Log meals from a photo, voice note or sentence, Show calories and protein left for the day and per meal, Correct or delete logged food, Log weight and body composition, Log steps, workouts and water, Weekly nutrition trends against targets, Suggest and set daily targets from a goal

payload.name: gFit Home Workouts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: gFit creates customized, equipment-free home workout routines tailored to your fitness goals. Specify your target focus (abs, core, glutes, legs, upper body, or full body), set your difficulty level (easy, normal, or hard), and choose a style (strength training, cardio, or stretching). ChatGPT selects matching bodyweight exercises, explains each movement in chat, and launches an interactive player demonstrating the routine. Navigate using commands like 'next', 'skip' and 'back' and select 'Mark as Done' to track your progress — no account required.
payload.longDescription: gFit会根据您的健身目标创建定制的、无需器械的居家锻炼计划。指定您的训练重点（腹部、核心、臀部、腿部、上半身或全身），设置难度等级（简单、常规或困难），并选择训练类型（力量训练、有氧运动或拉伸）。ChatGPT会选取匹配的自重训练动作，在聊天中解释每个动作，并启动交互式播放器演示训练流程。通过'下一步'、'跳过'和'返回'等指令进行操作，并选择'标记为完成'来记录进度——无需账户。

payload.name: KiloJ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
KiloJ is a calorie and nutrition tracker. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your KiloJ account so you can track what you eat and drink by just describing it.

What you can do:
- Log meals from a text description or a food photo, with calories, protein, carbs and fat estimated per item
- Search foods and log individual entries or custom foods
- Record water intake and body weight
- Review daily calories and macros against your goals, meal-type breakdowns, weekly averages and logging streaks

Who it is for: people who already use KiloJ, or want to, and prefer logging food and checking their progress in conversation.

Limitations: a KiloJ account is required. Nutrition values from text and photos are estimates. The plugin only reads and changes your own KiloJ data. KiloJ is a general wellness tool and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
payload.longDescription:
KiloJ是一款卡路里与营养追踪工具。该插件将ChatGPT与您的KiloJ账户连接，您只需描述食物即可追踪摄入的饮食。

可执行操作：
- 通过文本描述或食物照片记录餐食，可估算每项的卡路里、蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪含量
- 搜索食物并记录单个条目或自定义食物
- 记录饮水量和体重数据
- 查看每日卡路里和宏量营养素摄入量与目标值的对比，包含餐型分类、周均值和记录连续性

适用人群：已使用或计划使用KiloJ的用户，以及偏好通过对话方式记录饮食并查看进展的人群。

使用限制：需要拥有KiloJ账户。
通过文本和照片获取的营养数据为估算值。
该插件仅读取和修改您的个人KiloJ数据。
KiloJ是通用健康工具，不提供医疗建议、诊断或治疗。

payload.name: Praetor Health

Explore Praetor Health's public UK blood-test catalogue in ChatGPT. Browse by health goal, biomarker, concern, collection method or budget. Compare test prices, biomarker coverage, eligibility and collection options, then open the relevant product page at praetor.health.

The app uses public product information only. It cannot access your Praetor account, orders or results, place an order or book an appointment. It provides product information, not medical advice, and cannot diagnose, confirm or rule out a condition.

Useful when you feel off, have mixed or intense feelings, want to check in with yourself, or want to find words before talking with someone. No How We Feel account is needed. This experience helps you name feelings; it does not diagnose conditions, determine the causes of feelings, or save a check-in to the How We Feel app.

payload.name: YouCaps PT
payload.description: 更聪明地训练，更强劲地生活。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
YouCaps PT gives clear, practical training guidance for busy adults (around 40 and over) who want to get stronger, fitter and stay active for the long run. Ask about strength, conditioning, recovery and longevity and get educational, no-nonsense answers grounded in a curated knowledge base, in both Dutch and English.

What it can do:
- Answer training questions (how many sets, how often, progressive overload, rest between sets, programming for 2, 3 or 4 days a week, short 30-minute sessions, combining strength and cardio, coming back after a break, and more).
- Show visual exercise cards: a large demonstration image plus the exercise name and the key technique points, for squat, hinge, horizontal and vertical push and pull, single-leg work, carries and core. Cards appear in the language of your request (Dutch or English).
- Explain how to adjust your training with wearable recovery signals (read sensibly: one low score is not a reason to skip).
- Share confirmed, public information about YouCaps PT and personal trainer Giscard Martin, and the coaching options.

What it will not do: it is educational, not a diagnosis or personal medical or supplement advice; it has no access to personal accounts, wearable data or any database; it is read-only and takes no bookings or payments.
payload.longDescription:
YouCaps PT为忙碌的成年人（约40岁以上）提供清晰实用的训练指导，帮助您长期保持强健体魄与活跃状态。您可以就力量训练、体能提升、恢复训练和健康长寿相关问题进行咨询，获取基于精选知识库的教育性解答，支持荷兰语和英语双语服务。

核心功能：
- 解答训练相关问题（包括组数设定、训练频率、渐进式超负荷原则、组间休息时间、每周2/3/4天的训练计划、30分钟短时训练方案、力量与有氧训练结合方式、休息后恢复训练方法等）
- 展示可视化训练卡片：包含动作示范大图、动作名称及关键技巧要点，覆盖深蹲、硬拉、水平/垂直推拉、单腿训练、搬运类动作及核心训练模块。卡片内容根据请求语言（荷兰语/英语）显示
- 解释如何根据可穿戴设备的恢复信号调整训练强度（需理性解读：单次低分值不等于必须跳过训练）
- 提供YouCaps PT平台及私人教练Giscard Martin的公开信息，包含教练资质说明与课程服务详情

以下内容不提供：本工具为教育性质，不涉及疾病诊断或个人医疗/营养建议；无法访问个人账户、可穿戴设备数据或任何数据库；为只读模式，不处理预约或支付操作。

Health data stays in ChatGPT. Availability of ChatGPT Health depends on the user account and region. Interface generation time and details vary by model.

界面生成时间和具体细节因模型而异。

No Joy2Move account is required. This library provides general exercise information, not diagnosis, treatment or personalized rehabilitation advice. Results are limited to the available catalog, and video availability can change.
